ios-specialized|Generative AI.summary: AI conversation additions use existing controls, retain drafts and mark generated output without a new color.

variants.name: PromptInput: Single line
variants.use: Write, attach context and choose an available model before explicitly sending a prompt.
variants.swiftui: Enter sends once; Shift+Enter starts a line. IME composition does not submit. Failed requests retain the draft; Stop delegates transport cancellation.
variants.uikit: Use native accessible controls and retained caller-owned draft.
variants.appkit: Use native accessible controls and the same explicit request boundary.

variants.name: AIChat: Panel
variants.use: Have an explicitly identified conversation with AI while retaining review, citations and caller-owned history.
variants.swiftui: Suggestions fill the draft and focus it without sending. Caller owns each response and transport. Source links navigate; feedback, regenerate and refine are explicit.

states.name: Generating
states.behavior: Offer a named Stop action and retain partial output without speaking every token.

states.name: Failed
states.behavior: Keep the draft and explain how to try again.

swiftui: // Keep caller-owned model transport separate from the native composer.
// Announce the complete response; never announce every token.
uikit: // Keep failed drafts and expose an explicit stop action.
appkit: // Retain the draft while the caller owns the transport.
